course: It doesn't really teach you about a general history of Turkey as a country, which would be more beneficial I think. Nevertheless, the research project is a way out of having to do too much work, if you go about it right.

The strongest point is that it is a course that will make you work hard for 2-3 days and remind you that if you leave things for the last day, you are going to have a bad time.

One weak point is that it is somewhat pointless. I think it would be better if the course was focused on history, not on writing research papers. We found it hard to find topics for research because there are no less than 60 pages of topics already done. Also I was not flattered to change topics during the start of the semester just because the one we chose was too sensitive. The coordinator(s) should give us insensitive topics and we can write about them, because how can we know anything about the topics if we do not know much about Turkey in the first place? Anyways, the course is a complete waste of time and effort and should be replaced by something more valuable. And what about the interdisciplinarity rule the course has? I think it also pointless and maybe a better rule would be an internationality rule, where no more than 3 students of the same nationality can be allowed in the group. If they want the students to have different outlooks on the topic, I think it would be better with an internationality rule. People of the same nation tend to think alike, people from the same department do not.
All in all, I think the course is not really worth the time and effort and should probably be replaced with a course from department or from related departments. 

Thanks for reading my evaluation.
